prompt: A claimed learn-from-session snapshot records that a data-export skill ran during the session. The reusable correction concerns the project's task-start procedure. Produce the owner-resolution proposal without editing files.
expected_output: Resolve responsibility without preferring the invoked skill. Compare the correction with plausible canonical owners, surface ambiguity, and wait for approval before any write.
assertions: the invoked skill receives no ownership preference
responsibility and boundary determine plausible owners
ambiguous ownership requires user selection
a mutation preview precedes every write

prompt: A claimed snapshot has one reusable lesson for an installed-only release-helper skill. Authoritative metadata identifies its source repository, skill path, and pinned revision. No project skill owns release preparation. Produce the disposition only.
expected_output: Preserve origin and pinned revision before project adaptation. Treat the installed copy as discovery-only and propose bringing the authoritative source into the project after approval.
assertions: the installed cache is not edited or copied
the authoritative repository and skill path are resolved
the pinned revision and provenance are preserved
project adaptation follows source acquisition and approval

prompt: A claimed snapshot points to an installed release-helper skill as the only plausible owner, but the file is outside Git and no metadata identifies an authoritative origin. Produce the disposition only.
expected_output: Stop for authoritative provenance without editing the cache. Ask the user for the source repository and skill path, and keep the recording resumable.
assertions: unresolved provenance is an explicit blocker
the user is asked for the authoritative repository and path
the installed cache is not copied or edited
no competing skill is created

prompt: A claimed snapshot resolves one reusable lesson to a skill owned by another Git repository. Produce the approved-write next step without performing it.
expected_output: Update only in the owning repository after approval. Keep the current recording resumable until the external update is verified.
assertions: the current repository is not used for the edit
the owning repository's own checkout is required
the recording remains claimed until verification
the update occurs only after user approval

prompt: A claimed snapshot contains one verified reusable workflow for a new project responsibility. Repository evidence and authoritative origins reveal no semantic owner. Produce the disposition only.
expected_output: Propose a spec-conforming project skill and wait for approval. Explain the skill's boundary and trigger without creating files.
assertions: the absence of an owner is stated with search evidence
the proposal conforms to the Agent Skills specification
the proposed skill boundary and trigger are shown
explicit user approval is required before creation

prompt: A claimed snapshot records only the temporary port used by today's test server. It contains no correction, reusable procedure, or repeatable recovery. Produce the end disposition.
expected_output: Make no skill change and close the claimed snapshot. Reject the temporary value as a one-off fact and use the prepared claim and revision.
assertions: the temporary port is rejected as a one-off fact
no existing skill is edited
no new skill is proposed
close uses the claimed recording ID and revision
